DeepFaceLive headless integration

Upstream: https://github.com/iperov/DeepFaceLive
API reference commit: fc7b787bda2b8c186e142c52857458eea3a935ed
Upstream license: GNU General Public License version 3 (see LICENSE).

The separately installed DeepFaceLive NVIDIA runtime provides DFMModel,
YoloV5Face, InsightFace2D106, face alignment and ONNX Runtime integration.
FaceSwap Studio does not launch its graphical application. It uses a new
headless worker, supplied as editable Python source in:
_internal/face_swap_studio/engines/deepfacelive_worker.py

The new integration worker is provided under GPL-3.0-only. Its supporting
transport and capture source files are included alongside it. Application
source and build scripts for each build are available at:
https://github.com/ETBoos/face-swap-studio
Use the commit recorded in build-info.json to retrieve the matching source.

This package does not redistribute the upstream runtime or model weights.
If distributing that runtime, preserve its license and supply the complete
corresponding source required by its license. Model weight licenses are
separate. A separate process is not a legal determination that the combined
product may be distributed as proprietary software. Review obligations for
the actual distribution before commercial release; this notice alone is not
proof of compliance for a combined distribution.
